header: Former apprentices and where they work now
lead: Since 1998, 26 apprentices have finished their training at Aubruck. These are the ones who agreed to be listed.
note: If you worked here and want to be added or removed, write to Katja Sunder. We only list people who have agreed.

people.title: Verena Kolb
people.text: Now at the Sandau city planning office, which used to be one of our clients.

people.title: Simon Baumgartner
people.text: Teaches surveying at the technical college in Sandau. Simon has taught three of our apprentices.

people.title: Miriam Deutsch
people.text: Project manager at a rail contractor. Still calls Milan with measuring questions.

people.title: Nikolaus Ferk
people.text: Runs a two-person surveying office in Nauwang. We pass work to each other most months.

people.title: Tanja Ebersberg
people.text: Moved to the cadastral office in Sandau, which holds half the district's boundary files.

people.title: Josef Rauner
people.text: Retired. Comes in twice a year to read old field books that nobody else can.
